decisions: All nine videos keep source video resolution, frame count, frame rate, colors and visual duration; unused audio is removed because demonstrations are silent.

Photo WebP quality 92; responsive cover widths 760/1240/2480/4096; desktop Hero widths 1240/2480.
Graduation photo 2040x1360 preserves 3:2 and supports the existing 340px square crop at 4x density (1360px height).
Stage 10.2.3: 21 replaced originals copied from the project to permanent external backup, SHA-256 verified, then removed individually; optimized media unchanged.
WebP is used for current Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari; original files remain available for rollback in permanent external backup.
The archived libero-capa.png is actually JPEG; its original name and bytes are preserved in external backup.

browser.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/156.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
browser.videoFunctionalChecks: Nine videos: near-only source activation once, visible autoplay, silent/inline/loop, offscreen pause, resume, rapid scroll, direct anchor, reduced motion and manual playback.
browser.otherChecks: Nine anchors, active indicator/Hero/Footer, sticky/static under 484px, image decoding, no-JS photos, source/autoplay failures, Home intro wheel/touch/keyboard and Home/Case navigation.

performance.interpretation: Previous stage numbers are individual runs; current values are medians of three. Home Lighthouse does not dismiss the intro. Mobile Case LCP ranged from 2.50 to 5.56 seconds; the slow run included Adobe font transfers around 3.18 seconds. Do not attribute all LCP variation to media compression.

videoNetwork.method: Actual Chrome DevTools network/CPU throttling. Same optimized images in both modes; temporary test server switches only MP4 content between original and optimized files. Three valid cold starts per mode/profile.
videoNetwork.tourProtocol: One run per mode/profile: DOM order, center each video, wait until ready/playing, watch 1 second, settle 1 second after ninth. Transfer is encoded CDP bytes received, not declared Content-Length; completed requests include headers, in-flight requests include received bodies.

limitations.error: Error: Tour video 7 did not start

videoNetwork.interpretation: Original mobile tour exceeded the 90-second polling budget at micro_2; no complete before-tour transfer is reported. Original first-start measurement was retried without a tour to obtain three valid control starts.

additionalTotalResourceTours.method: Actual throttled network; one complete traversal per profile. Same DOM-order protocol: wait for playback, watch one second per video, settle one second after ninth. These independent samples supplement the planned three cold-start measurements; they are not included in those medians.

totals.scope: All files under assets/, including CSS, JavaScript, PDF and seven .gitkeep placeholders; decimal bytes.

validation.browser: Chrome headless, local HTTP with Range support; cache disabled in video/layout/functional checks
limitations: Desktop Chrome with mobile viewport/touch emulation; physical devices and other browser engines not tested.
External social destinations and link attributes checked; remote authenticated profile availability not assessed.
No new Lighthouse run: this stage removes unreferenced files and does not change active loading or media bytes.

cleanup.note: Historical optimization measurements in validation are retained from stage 10.2.2. Active media are listed in cleanup.activeMedia; assets[].original records describe externally archived provenance, not deployable resource paths.
